news.headline: Moody was signed by the Falcons off the Ravens' practice squad Tuesday, and he was able to put together a perfect debut
news.detail: Moody was signed by the Falcons off the Ravens' practice squad Tuesday, and he was able to put together a perfect debut with the team in Week 10.
